name: LiPo charger module (TP4056 with protection, USB-C)
description: Charges a 1S LiPo from USB 5 V (constant current, then 4.2 V constant voltage) and protects it. BAT (B+) and GND.2 (B−) to the cell, OUT (OUT+) and GND.3 (OUT−) to your circuit (e.g. VSYS of a 3.3 V board). Plug USB with press (or prop usb), or feed 5 V into VIN (IN+). Red LED = charging, blue = full. The charge current is 1 A as sold: for a small cell lower it to 1C (chargeCurrentmA, R_PROG).

pins.label: IN+
pins.description: 5 V input (same as the USB socket). 4.5 to 5.5 V; 8 V absolute max.

pins.label: OUT+
pins.description: Protected battery output (3.0 to 4.2 V) to the load, e.g. VSYS / BAT of a 3.3 V board. Not 5 V: add a boost converter for 5 V boards.

props.label: USB cable plugged in
props.description: A USB charger gives the module 5 V. press toggles it.

props.label: Charge current (R_PROG)
props.description: Set by R_PROG: 1.2 kΩ = 1000 mA (as sold), 2 kΩ = 580, 3 kΩ = 400, 5 kΩ = 250, 10 kΩ = 130. Keep it at or below the cell's capacity (1C).

footprint: 28 × 17.5 mm module, USB-C socket, solder pads IN+ IN− B+ B− OUT+ OUT−

bindings.description: The protection has cut OUT off (cell below 2.4 V).
